d43: You bury Camila. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+2 trauma)

deathBeatLines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Camila Pawlowski is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: 🕯️ Camila Pawlowski is dead — lockjaw. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Camila — and Camila is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

echoSample: d43: "Good question." "Camila owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
d43: "Camila always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
d43: "Since Camila died... I keep expecting to see Camila at the fire. Stupid."
d43: "I keep turning over the last thing Camila said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
d47: "Good question." "Huh. I answered that once — back when the answer was simpler." "Camila is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
d47: "I'm picking up Camila's share of the work. Someone should, and it might as well be me."

d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.

d40: "Camila's gone." Milagros looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Camila." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.

d40: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Gabriel Miranda, 55 — a Chef. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Green Whisper.

d40: At the grave, Milagros speaks for Gabriel — "Camila trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Gabriel before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
